OTECH LT-110H Bluetooth Label Maker with QWERTY Keyboard – Smart, Portable Label Printing Solution

Take control of clutter and streamline your organization with the Otech LT-110H Bluetooth Label Maker, a compact, easy-to-use label printer ideal for home, office, school, and business use. Equipped with a built-in QWERTY keyboard, Bluetooth connectivity, and ink-free thermal printing, this label maker delivers fast, high-quality labels—anytime, anywhere.

Whether you're labeling files, jars, storage boxes, wires, or retail items, the Otech LT-110H combines powerful features with a lightweight design for everyday efficiency.

Key Features:

  • Wireless Bluetooth Connectivity
    Connects quickly to iOS and Android devices via the Otech Label app for convenient, app-based printing.

  • QWERTY Keyboard & LCD Screen
    Built-in physical keyboard and screen allow standalone label creation—no phone or computer needed.

  • Ink-Free Thermal Printing
    Uses direct thermal printing technology—no ink, no mess, no hassle. Just load the tape and print.

  • Rechargeable & Portable
    USB rechargeable battery supports long-lasting use. Compact and lightweight for on-the-go labeling.

  • Customizable Labels
    Choose from multiple fonts, styles, icons, borders, and sizes to create professional or personalized labels.
